operation: Operator manually suspended and woke the host with MiniFuse left connected; the observer only read state and kernel clocks.
listening_after_resume: Operator confirmed clean music in both headphones.
limits: One suspend/resume cycle on one MiniFuse at 48 kHz.
Settled time is measured from observer detection after resume, not a precise hardware wake latency.
The one-second complete digital capture establishes signal in both channels without clipping; pw-cat returned status 1 with empty stderr.
Ardour was already stopped by the preceding host PipeWire restart; DAW engine recovery is not covered.
This is not an endurance, reboot, kernel-upgrade or other-rate test.
Serials, personal paths, voice and music are omitted.
